name: maximal_cliques
author: a018559c
description: Uses pivoted Bron-Kerbosch search to find the largest maximal cliques in a graph, treating directed edges as undirected adjacency. Returns up to top_k cliques ranked by size with deterministic node-ID tie-breaking, registers each returned clique as a subgraph, and sets result_graph_id to the largest clique.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of largest maximal cliques to return.
